requirement: `contents_of_node` queues a node by its domain ID. The SDK prepares, formats, and records its contents on delivery in the same way as `contents_of_current_node`.
rationale:
**Obligations** in `requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.named_input`:
1. `contents_of_node` queues the node with the given domain ID. That node is the named one, not the current node.
2. The SDK prepares, formats and records that node's contents on delivery, the same way as for `contents_of_current_node`.

**Coverage**
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[task_messages_share_a_prefix_and_can_queue_another_node]` carries `{test}` for this requirement.
  - The current node is 1 and the named node is 2 with contents "selected source". The ask uses `.contents_of_node(selected)` and is awaited twice, once per task message.
  - Every recorded request must have inputs exactly `[(2, "selected source")]`. The named node is queued, and only it, so a version that queued the current node instead would fail.
  - After delivery, `ctx.dependencies()` must equal `[Dependency::Node(selected, fp("selected source"))]`. This checks that the content is recorded with its snapshot fingerprint, and that the record is for the named node.
- I read `crates/trust-but-verify/src/procedure.rs#impl[Ask<'a, 'd, D, R, P>]#2/fn[execute]`. `contents_of_node` only pushes `Insertion::Node` and has no conditional of its own. `execute` turns `Insertion::Node` and `Insertion::Current` into a node list, and one loop handles both. That loop calls `prepare_read`, `format()`, redaction and recording. So preparation, formatting and delivery-time recording are shared with `contents_of_current_node`. The text asks only for sameness with that path. The shared behaviors (redaction, repeated reads, prepared pages not recorded on delivery failure) are asserted through `contents_of_current_node` in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs`. Examples are `queued_contents_and_graph_read_tools_redact_credentials_before_delivery` and `graph_tools_record_delivered_snapshots_and_prepared_pages_do_not_record_delivery`. The named-node test shows the named path reaches that same machinery.
- `src/authoring/mod.rs#mod[tests]/fn[citation_reviews_use_their_prompt_and_record_the_item_and_citations]` also carries the mark. The authoring review in `src/authoring/sdk.rs` calls `contents_of_node` for extra mandatory inputs. That test checks the complete mandatory set appears in the prompt and that the recorded inputs number two. It is additional end-to-end coverage, not needed for adequacy.

**Gaps:** none found. The requirement has no separate boundary or failure case of its own. A wrong implementation would be caught by the input and dependency assertions. Examples are queuing the wrong node, not recording the dependency, or recording it with a different fingerprint.

text: `contents_of_node` queues a node by its domain ID. The SDK prepares, formats, and records its contents on delivery in the same way as `contents_of_current_node`.
Node-insertion methods queue selections. They resolve no contents or edges,
render no inputs, and record no observations while building.
Awaiting with a configured agent resolves these selections in call order:
| `contents_of_successors(label)` | Targets of edges whose labels equal `label`, in returned edge order, including duplicate targets. |
Each successful successor selection records its source, label, and target-set
fingerprint, even when nothing matches. Only selected targets have their contents
resolved. Each delivered node is recorded with its supplied snapshot's
Marks an agent request that has begun collecting node contents. Further node inputs can be added before awaiting the answer.
